name: [🏁] +1 Speed Brainrot Escape
desc:
Every step makes you faster! 👟 Build insane speed, avoid hungry Brainrots, and escape before they catch you!

⚡ HOW TO PLAY:
👟 Walk or run to gain +1 Speed every step
🏃 Train on treadmills to become even faster
🧠 Dodge the hungry Brainrots chasing you
🔥 Keep moving and build as much speed as possible
🏁 Become fast enough to escape!

Can you outrun every Brainrot and become the fastest player?

👍 Like and favorite the game for future updates!
